Clara Zhou: quick sync  launch orbit for Nimbus HW + SI bundle. main asks: hero assets, press list, SI contact, and smoke tests. target launch Wed 07:00 PT.

Clara Zhou: we'll ask Nimbus for outlet name. also confirm whether quote is vendor or customer-led. prefer vendor-led.
Miguel Torres: microsite note  add an "SI quickstart" CTA (3 bullets) and a tiny GIF of install. keeps support volume down.
Hannah Li: agreed. also want a single paragraph for the blog highlighting joint ops benefits + a short vendor quote.
QA-bot: smoke-test checklist uploaded: /runbooks/nimbus-smoke v1.0. includes latency check, auth flow, and SKU validation.
Miguel Torres: ops fallback: if HW images missing at cutover, use placeholder hero + hide badge until provided. prevents blocking listing.
ops-bot: staging deploy scheduled Tue 17:00 PT. approvers: partnerships, eng-platform, marketing. reminder set.
Clara Zhou: final blockers?
Hannah Li: get outlet name for early hands-on and NDA.
Miguel Torres: confirm GIF + badge delivery by Mon EOD.
Clara Zhou: I'll consolidate checklist and post link here at 12:30 PT. thanks :white_check_mark:
